_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score/leg are coiled flat with no active breaker; 7-day base rate favors HOLD and the blowoff analog is diverging, so stay on the current rung until momentum-funding-vol expand together.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency-band coil; narrative only notes F&G greed print with no forward phase/direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound, 30d momentum ~50, funding subdued, cycle score stable in-band
next_move.invalidated_if: Vol expansion breaks the coil downside, or joint thrust in momentum, funding, and fear/greed lifts score >1 rung
